quest.title: The Lost Hilichurl
quest.description: The unusual fellow may have gotten away in the end, but at least the merchant route is safe again.

talks.objective: Report back to the Adventurers' Guild

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Greetings, Adventurer! I have already been informed about your completion of the commission. The Guild is grateful for your ongoing support! Here is your compensation.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Although you were unable to capture the Unusual Hilichurl and we still cannot ascertain the reason for the recent spate of disturbances... the wilderness is much safer now, so thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: On a related note, Ella Musk is waiting for you in the library.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Ya ika!!! ...O—Oh, it's just you, phew... Goodness, you gave me the fright of my life. Please, I'd appreciate it if you didn't interrupt me like that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How are we interrupting when you called us here in the first place!?

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Hmm...? Oh, it's you! Thanks for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: So, is the handbook accurate? Did it prove useful in interacting with the hilichurls?

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: Well! Either way, my dictionary has been further refined, and we've obtained more evidence to support my thesis that harmonious coexistence between human and hilichurl kind is viable.

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: Still, it is a pity that we didn't get the opportunity to converse with the Unusual Hilichurl...

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: But from the linguistic corpus I have managed to assemble thus far, it seems likely that it was simply looking to make some friends in an unfamiliar land.

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: It is a real pity that you didn't get to converse with it...

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: Ah, I almost forgot — this is for you, as thanks for your help.

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: You helped me a lot here, and I do apologize for having put you through so much trouble... But I do hope I will have the pleasure of working with you again in the future.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well now, isn't that very polite of you all of a sudden...

choices.text: I would have preferred to handle this my way.
